content.comment_body: Hello, I have two [product_name] controllers with [article_no]. Both are connected to a router via Ethernet cables, and the routers themselves are linked by Wi-Fi. Occasionally, the [product_name] controller reports a network connection error, even though the network status displays as OK. The error isn't cleared automatically, and during this time, all outputs on both controllers are reset. If accessed online through a PC, the error clears and outputs are re-enabled. The issue also resolves when stopping and restarting the program from the controller menu. The error seems to occur specifically when the router is powered off and on again; simply unplugging and reconnecting the Ethernet cable restores the connection without errors. Is there a way to handle this issue so the error clears automatically?

I connected to the [product_name] and when unplugging and replugging the cable, I saw a notification about a network violation followed by recovery. This report remained active until I pressed the OK button twice, but the [product_name] started functioning right after reconnecting the cable, even without pressing any buttons.

analysis.insight_summary: Users describe intermittent network connectivity issues with two [product_name] controllers, each connected to separate routers that communicate via Wi-Fi. Occasionally, errors about lost network connection persist in the device status even after physical connectivity is restored, requiring users to manually clear the error or restart the program. During these errors, all controller outputs are reset, leading to interruption of normal operations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users prefer that the [product_name] controllers automatically restore network connections and output states following brief network disruptions, without needing manual intervention or resets.
